messages:
Nadia (CS): Quick run: Orion SupplyChain needs a short LatAm allowlist + rate bump for a partner integration demo tomorrow. Onboarding shows low steady traffic but the partner gateway can spike requests. Renewal touchpoint ~25 days out, so this demo is a key moment. Request: pin to sa-east-1 and allow 198.51.101.0/24 for 6h. QPS 220, burst 450. Customer id OS-9920.

Ethan (Acct Exec): They called out São Paulo latency in the feedback survey. If we can show stable p95 and low error rate during rehearsal it helps the renewal conversation. I'll be on the call.

Vik (SRE): Need confirmation on client IPs, header name, and whether they authenticate via NAT pool or rotating proxies. Plan: canary 10m before demo then roll full; auto-revoke after window.

Nadia (CS): Partner endpoint NATs live in 198.51.101.0/24 and may rotate. Header: X-OS-Token. Window: 2026-04-15T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-15T08:00:00Z (6h). They will warm up client 30m prior.

Sofia (Solutions): Recommend KV prefix warmup and a short 15m ramp. I'll upload a harness to /shared/cs/warmups/OS-9920. Also recommend collecting p95, tail latency and error rate per-minute.

Vik (SRE): Draft config i'm about to apply. Canary 10m. Rollback if p95 > 210ms or errors > 1% during canary.

Vik (SRE): ```json
{
  "customer_id":"OS-9920",
  "region_pin":"sa-east-1",
  "allowlist":["198.51.101.0/24"],
  "require_header":"X-OS-Token",
  "rate_limits":{"qps":220,"burst":450},
  "start":"2026-04-15T02:00:00Z",
  "end":"2026-04-15T08:00:00Z",
  "canary":{"duration":"10m","rollback_p95_ms":210,"rollback_error_pct":1},
  "telemetry":"masked_prompts_aggregate",
  "audit_log":true,
  "notes":"6h LatAm demo; auto-revoke; warmup planned; renewal follow-up on success"
}
```

infra-bot: Applying canary now (canary window 10m). Ticket: CS-7599. Requestor: Vik.

Vik (SRE): Canary started at 6191234665. Quick smoke: p95 98ms, errors 0.2%.

Vik (SRE): Canary healthy  rolling to full apply for OS-9920 in sa-east-1. Full apply completed at 6191234780.

Nadia (CS): Awesome :tada: I'll notify Orion with the window and header reminder, and log the demo in CRM. Ethan  can you draft renewal follow-up linking success metrics to our proposal? Sofia  please share the warmup harness and test plan.

Ethan (Acct Exec): On it. I'll draft a conditional renewal note proposing a 12-month pilot discount if demo meets p95 < 140ms and error < 0.5% for 24h post-demo.

Sofia (Solutions): Warmup harness uploaded to /shared/cs/warmups/OS-9920 and scheduled 30m before start. Link: https://internal.storage/warmups/OS-9920

Nadia (CS): Closing loop. This is ephemeral and will auto-revoke after the window. I'll attach telemetry summary to the account after the demo.
